narrative.overview: The interface behaves like an institutional registry: a bound ledger of courses, enrolments, results, and credit. A committed navy shell (#08355c, the authentic EuroAfrica header blue) holds an ivory paper ground where every record is ruled, numbered, and stamped. Serif display type (Source Serif 4) gives headings the weight of an engraved title page; spaced small-caps labels mark each surface like a register's section head. Density is calm but information-forward; nothing glows, floats, or gradients.
keyCharacteristics: Navy rail + ivory paper ground; never reversed mid-flow
Hairline .ledger rows instead of floating cards for record lists
.register small-caps labels and .folio record numbers as signature marks
Seal gold reserved for stamp moments (active states, seals, rare accents)
Serif display confined to headings; everything else is Instrument Sans

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Registry blue is the only action color. Gold is a seal, not a button color — except .btn-gold, reserved for checkout and completion ceremonies.

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: Content lives on paper or white cards. Navy never appears inside the content column; it is the shelf, not the page.

rules.name: The Serif Boundary Rule
rules.body: Source Serif 4 appears only in .h1/.h2 and the brand wordmark context. Buttons, tables, badges, and nav stay in Instrument Sans.

rules.name: The Flat Register Rule
rules.body: Ledger rows, tables, and nav are hairline-ruled, never shadowed. Shadow means 'detached sheet,' and only the sign-in sheet detaches.

dos: Do open every surface with .register label + hairline + .h1 — the title-page rhythm.
Do use .ledger for record lists; hairlines instead of stacked cards.
Do keep gold to stamps: seals, active edges, .btn-gold ceremonies.
Do hold icon-only touch targets at ≥44px and text contrast at ≥4.5:1.
Do use the authentic public/brand/eman-logo.png via <x-ui.brand>; never redraw the mark.
donts: Don't put navy surfaces inside the content column, or paper panels inside the rail.
Don't add gradients, glows, pill buttons, or shadowed list rows.
Don't introduce a second accent color or a monospace face — folios use letterspaced sans.
Don't use serif below text-lg or on interactive controls.
Don't create public marketing pages; the register begins at sign-in.
